bites.title: Hands off the sliders
bites.body: Pros barely touch the toolbar. One hand on the pen, one hand on the keys. Let's wire your left hand (or right, fellow lefties).

bites.title: [ and ]
bites.body: Tap {key:decrease_brush_size|[} and {key:increase_brush_size|]} to shrink and grow the brush.

bites.title: Shift + drag
bites.body: Hold Shift and drag the pen left or right on the canvas. The size follows your hand. Faster than brackets for big jumps.

bites.title: I and O
bites.body: {key:decrease_opacity|I} lowers opacity, {key:increase_opacity|O} raises it. Try both.

bites.title: E for eraser
bites.body: {key:erase_action|E} flips the current brush into an eraser and back. Erase a little, then press E again.

bites.title: X swaps colors
bites.body: Your foreground and background colors live at the bottom of the toolbox. {key:toggle_fg_bg|X} swaps them. Painting black? X: now you're painting white.

bites.title: D for default
bites.body: {key:reset_fg_bg|D} snaps back to black and white.

bites.title: K and L
bites.body: {key:make_brush_color_darker|K} darkens your color a notch, {key:make_brush_color_lighter|L} lightens it. Handy for quick value shifts.

bites.title: Ctrl + click to sample
bites.body: I painted an apple. Hold Ctrl and click it with the pen: you just grabbed its red without switching tools.
bites.hint: Sampling grabs the color under the pen. The P tool does the same thing as a full tool.

bites.title: 05 cleared
bites.body: [ ] Shift-drag, I O, E, X, D, K L, Ctrl-click. Your off hand just got a job.
